# Amazon Prime Video
> Amazon Prime Video is a streaming service for movies, TV shows, live sports, channels, rentals, and purchases.

Prime Video lets users browse, watch, rent, buy, and manage video content across devices, with support for subscriptions, account settings, parental controls, and help resources.

## Watch and Browse
- [Prime Video Home](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/storefront): Main Prime Video storefront for browsing featured movies, series, channels, and live events.
- [Prime Video Store](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/storefront/ref=atv_hm_hom_1_c_9zZ8D2_2_1): Entry point for discovering included, rentable, and purchasable video titles.
- [TV Shows](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/storefront/ref=atv_nb_tv): Browse television series, seasons, and episodes available on Prime Video.
- [Movies](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/storefront/ref=atv_nb_mv): Browse films available to stream, rent, or purchase on Prime Video.
- [Live TV](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/storefront/ref=atv_nb_livetv): Access live programming and linear channels available through Prime Video.
- [Sports](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/storefront/ref=atv_nb_sprt): Explore live sports and sports-related programming on Prime Video.

## Account and Settings
- [Your Account](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/settings): Manage Prime Video account preferences and service-related settings.
- [Your Watchlist](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/watchlist): View and manage saved movies and TV shows for later viewing.
- [Purchase History](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/library): Access purchased, rented, and previously watched video content.
- [Parental Controls](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/settings/parental-controls): Configure viewing restrictions, PIN requirements, and child-safe playback settings.
- [Subtitles and Audio](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/settings/subtitles): Manage subtitle appearance and related playback accessibility preferences.
- [Registered Devices](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/settings/devices): Review and manage devices registered to your Prime Video account.

## Channels and Subscriptions
- [Prime Video Channels](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/storefront/ref=atv_nb_chnl): Browse add-on channel subscriptions available through Prime Video.
- [Manage Your Channels](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/settings/channels): Review and manage active Prime Video channel subscriptions.
- [Subscriptions](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/settings/subscriptions): View recurring video-related subscriptions tied to your account.
- [Freevee](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/storefront/ref=atv_nb_free): Access ad-supported streaming content associated with Amazon’s video offerings.

## Apps and Devices
- [Prime Video Apps](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/getstarted): Learn how to watch Prime Video on supported phones, tablets, TVs, and streaming devices.
- [Supported Devices](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GUX9FYHU5D8LC9EJ): Reference supported devices and platform compatibility for Prime Video playback.
- [Download Prime Video Titles](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=202064950): Learn how offline downloads work for eligible Prime Video content.
- [Watch While Traveling](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=G3YJYV5CXY88R5QW): Understand regional availability and travel-related viewing limitations.
- [Accessibility Features](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=G7M8B8Z8G6W8J4D6): Review accessibility options such as subtitles, audio descriptions, and supported features.

## Help and Support
- [Prime Video Help](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=202095490): Main help hub for Prime Video account, playback, billing, and device support.
- [Troubleshoot Prime Video Streaming Issues](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GUX9FYHU5D8LC9EJ): Help for common playback, buffering, and device-related streaming problems.
- [Cancel Prime Video Channel Subscription](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=202095060): Instructions for canceling add-on channel subscriptions through Prime Video.
- [Prime Video PIN and Purchase Restrictions](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=G2N8897W4JY5CVS8): Guidance for setting and using account PIN and purchase controls.
- [Contact Amazon Customer Service](https://www.amazon.com/hz/contact-us): Contact options for account, billing, and Prime Video support issues.

## Rentals and Purchases
- [Rent or Buy Videos](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=202064890): Learn how movie and TV rentals and purchases work on Prime Video.
- [Prime Video Store Purchases](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/library): Access purchased and rented titles from your video library.
- [Pre-order Video Titles](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=202064900): Information about pre-ordering eligible digital video content.
- [Video Payment Settings](https://www.amazon.com/cpe/yourpayments/wallet): Manage payment methods used for Prime Video rentals, purchases, and subscriptions.

## Legal and Policies
- [Prime Video Terms of Use](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=202095170): Terms governing use of Prime Video services and digital video content.
- [Amazon Privacy Notice](https://www.amazon.com/privacy): Privacy practices applicable to Prime Video and Amazon account usage.
- [Cookies Notice](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=468496): Information about Amazon cookies and related tracking technologies.
- [Digital License Terms](https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201014950): Terms related to licensed digital content, access, and usage restrictions.

## Prime Membership
- [Amazon Prime](https://www.amazon.com/amazonprime): Overview of Amazon Prime membership and included benefits.
- [Prime Video with Prime](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/storefront/ref=atv_hp_nd_nav): Explore video content included with an Amazon Prime membership.
- [Manage Prime Membership](https://www.amazon.com/primecentral): Review billing, renewal, and membership management options for Amazon Prime.
